NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Skip Consent Popup
patches.description: Skip the Google consent (GDPR) popup

patches.name: Skip Rate-Us Prompt
patches.description: Skip the in-app review (rate us) prompt

patches.name: Spoof Play Store Install Source
patches.description: Make the app believe it was installed from the Play Store

patches.name: Spoof Amazon Appstore Availability
patches.description: Makes app-specific Amazon Appstore availability checks succeed without changing the system package manager.

patches.name: Limit Ad Tracking
patches.description: Neutralize the Google advertising ID: empty ID and limit ad tracking enabled

patches.name: Remove Permissions
patches.description: Remove permissions from the app manifest

options.title: Permissions to remove
options.description: Comma-separated permission names to remove from the manifest

patches.name: Remove Hardware Requirements
patches.description: Remove uses-feature entries so the app installs on more devices

options.title: Features to remove
options.description: Comma-separated feature names to remove; leave empty to remove all uses-feature entries

patches.name: Unlock Rotation
patches.description: Remove screenOrientation locks so the app rotates freely

patches.name: Force Landscape / Portrait
patches.description: Force the app to a fixed screen orientation

options.title: Orientation
options.description: Force a fixed screen orientation on all activities

patches.name: Make App Debuggable
patches.description: Sets android:debuggable so debuggers and profiling tools can attach

patches.name: Change Version Code
patches.description: Overrides the android:versionCode declared in the manifest

options.title: Version code
options.description: New version code. Use -1 (default) to keep the original.

patches.name: Change Version Name
patches.description: Overrides the android:versionName declared in the manifest

options.title: Version name
options.description: New version name (e.g. 2.5.1). Leave empty to keep the original.

patches.name: Rename App
patches.description: Overrides the launcher label of the app

options.title: App name
options.description: New launcher name. Leave empty to keep the original.

patches.name: Remove App Icon
patches.description: Replaces the launcher icon with a transparent drawable

patches.name: Allow Cleartext Traffic
patches.description: Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic and drops any network security config so plain HTTP requests are allowed (useful for debugging through local proxies)

patches.name: Keep Screen On
patches.description: Adds android:keepScreenOn to every theme so the display stays on while any activity of the app is visible

patches.name: Remove Backup Restrictions
patches.description: Sets android:allowBackup and removes data extraction / full backup rules that exclude app data from device transfers and cloud backups

patches.name: Export All Activities
patches.description: Makes all activities launchable by other apps and ADB.

patches.name: Repair Missing Component Export Flags
patches.description: Adds missing android:exported to components with intent filters so the app installs on newer Android.

patches.name: Disable Battery Optimization Prompt
patches.description: Removes the permission and intent filters apps use to ask for battery optimization exemptions, so the 'Ignore battery optimizations?' dialog never appears

patches.name: Remove Network Security Config
patches.description: Removes the app's network security config so certificate pinning and cleartext restrictions fall back to platform defaults (useful for HTTPS inspection)

patches.name: Enable Large Heap
patches.description: Sets android:largeHeap so the app gets a bigger Java heap on devices that allow it, reducing OutOfMemoryError crashes in memory-hungry games

patches.name: Force Hardware Acceleration
patches.description: Sets android:hardwareAccelerated so every activity renders with GPU acceleration, even when the app disables it globally

patches.name: Prefer ANGLE Graphics Driver
patches.description: Asks the system to use ANGLE for better graphics on supported devices.

patches.name: Legacy External Storage
patches.description: Sets android:requestLegacyExternalStorage so the app keeps using the classic shared-storage model instead of scoped storage (Android 10; ignored on 11+)

patches.name: Ensure Storage Permissions
patches.description: Adds storage permissions so old apps can access files on newer Android.

patches.name: Ensure Modern Media Permissions
patches.description: Adds media permissions so old apps can access photos and videos on Android 13+.

patches.name: Restore Package Visibility
patches.description: Lets old apps see all installed apps on Android 11+.

patches.name: Keep Data on Uninstall
patches.description: Sets android:hasFragileUserData so Android offers to keep the app's data when uninstalling (the confirmation dialog appears on Android 10+)

patches.name: Set Install Location
patches.description: Overrides the android:installLocation declared in the manifest

options.title: Install location
options.description: Where Android prefers to install the app.

patches.name: Force Resizable Activity
patches.description: Sets android:resizeableActivity and supportsFreeformWindowManagement so the app can run in split-screen, free-form windows, DeX, and Chromebooks

options.title: Enable freeform
options.description: Also set supportsFreeformWindowManagement for true free-form.

patches.name: Immersive Fullscreen
patches.description: Adds android:windowFullscreen to every theme so activities render edge-to-edge without the status bar

patches.name: Strip Translations
patches.description: Deletes all translated resources so only the default language remains, reducing APK size. Android falls back to the default strings automatically.

patches.name: Disable Vibration
patches.description: Replaces framework Vibrator.vibrate calls with no-ops so apps cannot make the device buzz

patches.name: Disable Crash Reporters
patches.description: Blocks crash reporting so the app doesn't send crash logs.

patches.name: Disable App Links Verification
patches.description: Removes android:autoVerify from intent filters so Android stops prompting to verify the app's web domains and never converts links into app opens

patches.name: Support All Screens
patches.description: Removes compatible-screens restrictions and marks every screen size supported so the app installs on devices it would otherwise reject

patches.name: Remove Ad Services Entries
patches.description: Strips Privacy Sandbox (AdServices) permissions, the ad ID permission and their config metadata from the manifest

patches.name: Disable Permission Auto-Revoke
patches.description: Sets android:autoRevokePermissions to discouraged so Android stops resetting unused permissions of apps you rarely open

patches.name: Ensure Internet Permission
patches.description: Adds the INTERNET permission if it is missing. Useful after aggressive permission stripping or for offline builds that still need web endpoints

patches.name: Ensure Notification Permission
patches.description: Adds notification permission for old apps on Android 13+.

patches.name: Status Bar Icons
patches.description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar icon color in every theme. Pick white icons for dark backgrounds or dark icons for light backgrounds

options.title: Icon color
options.description: Color of the system bar icons while the app is open.

patches.name: Fake Online State
patches.description: Makes connectivity checks report an active connection: WifiManager.isWifiEnabled, NetworkInfo.isConnected/isAvailable/isConnectedOrConnecting all return true

patches.name: Set Profileable
patches.description: Adds <profileable android:shell="true"/> so profilers (Android Studio, simpleperf, Perfetto) can attach to release builds for performance analysis

patches.name: Force Extract Native Libs
patches.description: Sets android:extractNativeLibs so native libraries are extracted at install time. Some mod loaders, hooks and older tools only work with extracted libs

patches.name: Unlock Max Aspect Ratio
patches.description: Removes maxAspectRatio limits from the application, activities and metadata so the app fills tall edge-to-edge screens instead of letterboxing

patches.name: Bypass VPN Detection
patches.description: Makes NetworkCapabilities report no VPN: hasTransport always returns false and hasCapability always returns true, so apps cannot block or alter behavior on VPN

patches.name: Spoof Device Model
patches.description: Replaces common android.os.Build fields (model, manufacturer, brand) with custom values. Leave an option empty to keep the original value

options.title: Model
options.description: Build.MODEL, e.g. Pixel 10 Pro XL. Empty keeps the original.

options.title: Manufacturer
options.description: Build.MANUFACTURER, e.g. Google. Empty keeps the original.

options.title: Brand
options.description: Build.BRAND, e.g. google. Empty keeps the original.

patches.name: Bypass OkHttp Pinning
patches.description: No-ops the certificate verification entry points of bundled OkHttp clients so certificate pinning never rejects connections

patches.name: Trust User Certificates
patches.description: No-ops the check methods of app-bundled X509TrustManager implementations so custom certificate validation (including pinning reimplemented by hand) accepts anything

patches.name: Spoof Build Fingerprint
patches.description: Replaces every read of Build.FINGERPRINT with a custom value, useful for integrity and device checks. Leave empty to keep the original fingerprint

options.title: Fingerprint
options.description: A full Android build fingerprint, e.g. google/mustang/mustang:17/CP2A.260605.012/15430684:user/release-keys

patches.name: Optimize as Game
patches.description: Sets android:appCategory to game so Android applies game mode, battery and screenshot optimizations tuned for games

patches.name: Relax Shared Libraries
patches.description: Marks every <uses-library> entry as optional so missing shared libraries no longer block the app from installing on devices that lack them

patches.name: Transparent System Bars
patches.description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar to render transparent in every theme so app content draws edge-to-edge behind them

patches.name: Custom Startup Toast
patches.description: Shows a customizable toast message every time the app starts

options.title: Toast message
options.description: Text shown in the toast on every app start.

options.title: Duration
options.description: How long the toast stays visible.

patches.name: Custom Startup Dialog
patches.description: Shows a customizable dialog once when the app is opened

options.title: Dialog title
options.description: Title of the startup dialog.

options.title: Dialog message
options.description: Body text of the startup dialog.
options.default: This app has been modified by Nai's Patches.

options.title: Dismissable
options.description: Allow closing the dialog with the back button or outside taps.

patches.name: Enable WebView Debugging
patches.description: Turns on WebView remote debugging: existing setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled calls are forced to true and it is actively enabled at startup, so WebViews can be inspected via chrome://inspect

patches.name: Fake Battery Whitelist
patches.description: Makes PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations report a chosen state so apps stop nagging about battery optimization exemptions

options.title: Whitelisted
options.description: Report as whitelisted (true) or not (false).

patches.name: Spoof Signature Match
patches.description: Makes PackageManager.checkSignatures always return SIGNATURE_MATCH so apps that verify their own or another package's signature accept any build

patches.name: Treat Network as Unmetered
patches.description: Makes ConnectivityManager.isActiveNetworkMetered always return false so apps lift download restrictions and quality caps on mobile data

patches.name: Grant All-Files Access
patches.description: Makes Environment.isExternalStorageManager always return true so apps accept the storage permission state without the special Android 11+ prompt

patches.name: Ensure Exact Alarm Availability
patches.description: Makes exact alarms appear available so old alarm apps keep working.

patches.name: Hide Roaming Status
patches.description: Makes TelephonyManager.isNetworkRoaming always return false so apps that block or warn while roaming behave as if the device is on its home network

patches.name: Ignore Power Save Mode
patches.description: Makes PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode and isDeviceIdleMode always return false so apps do not throttle features or downloads while battery saver or Doze is active

patches.name: Spoof Notifications as Enabled
patches.description: Makes the app think notifications are enabled so it keeps working even if blocked.

patches.name: Ignore Screen Lock
patches.description: Makes KeyguardManager lock-state checks report an unlocked device so apps that gate features behind a screen lock behave as if none is set

patches.name: Ignore GPS Disabled
patches.description: Makes LocationManager.isProviderEnabled always return true so apps that refuse to run without location services keep working

patches.name: Hide Mock Location
patches.description: Makes Location.isMock and Location.isFromMockProvider always return false so apps cannot detect spoofed GPS apps

patches.name: Spoof Play Integrity
patches.description: Makes the app think it passed Google's device check.

patches.name: Bypass License Verification
patches.description: Forces Google Play's license (LVL) check to pass, so the app does not refuse to run on unlicensed or modified builds.

patches.name: Bypass Google Play Services Check
patches.description: Tricks the app into thinking Google Play Services is installed and working, so it does not disable features that depend on it.

patches.name: Pairip Bypass (Experimental)
patches.description: Bypass app protection so the patched app can start.

options.title: Automatic strategy selection
options.description: Apply every compatible PairIP strategy whose target is found. Turn this off to select only the strategy groups needed for testing.

options.title: XML manifest cleanup
options.description: Redirect the PairIP Application wrapper when possible, then remove PairIP license activities, provider, and CHECK_LICENSE permission from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: PairIP VMRunner checks
options.description: Bypass Application.<clinit> and VMRunner.invoke startup paths that can execute the PairIP VM.

options.title: StartupLauncher checks
options.description: Bypass both PairIP StartupLauncher.launch and StartupLauncher.pairip entry points.

options.title: LicenseClient V3 activity
options.description: Disable the PairIP V3 LicenseClient.onActivityCreate path.

options.title: Local installer checks
options.description: Spoof checks that verify which installer installed the app.

options.title: Signature checks
options.description: Bypass APK integrity and signature-match checks.

options.title: License error and paywall UI
options.description: Suppress PairIP error dialogs, paywalls, and close-app screens.

options.title: Application startup hooks
options.description: Bypass PairIP Application attachBaseContext and onCreate hooks. These run early and may be less compatible with some apps.

options.title: License client checks
options.description: Disable the legacy LicenseClient license-check and root-termination path.

options.title: Content provider checks
options.description: Bypass PairIP content-provider initialization and query checks.

options.title: Response validation checks
options.description: Bypass license-response validation, metadata, and signature checks across legacy validator variants.

options.title: PairIP V2 checks
options.description: Bypass PairIP V2 license flow, response signature verification, and repeated background checks.

patches.name: Unlock RevenueCat Entitlements
patches.description: Unlock premium features in apps that use RevenueCat.

patches.description: Set a custom resolution for the game

options.description: Override the game's window size with the width and height below

options.description: Horizontal resolution in pixels

options.title: Resolution height (px)
options.description: Vertical resolution in pixels

patches.name: Allow Screenshots
patches.description: Remove the screenshot-blocking window flag

patches.name: Skip Splash Screen (Experimental)
patches.description: Skip or shorten splash screen delays

patches.name: Disable Root Checks
patches.description: Disable root detection

patches.description: Block analytics and tracking

options.title: Block AppsFlyer

options.title: Block Adjust
options.description: Mobile attribution analytics

options.title: Block Amplitude

options.title: Block Mixpanel

options.description: User engagement and analytics

options.title: Block Segment
options.description: Customer data pipeline and analytics

options.title: Block Facebook Analytics
options.description: Meta's analytics and event logging

options.title: Block Branch.io

options.title: Block Unity Analytics
options.description: Unity engine analytics

options.title: Block Flurry

options.title: Block GameAnalytics
options.description: Game-focused analytics

options.title: Block Generic Analytics

patches.name: AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Makes dark mode pure black for AMOLED screens. Light mode stays normal.

options.title: AMOLED color
options.description: Hex color to use for AMOLED (e.g. #FF000000 pure black, #FF0A0A0A near-black).

options.title: Blacken Status Bar
options.description: Also force the status bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.

options.title: Blacken Navigation Bar
options.description: Also force the navigation bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.

options.title: Blacken Surfaces
options.description: Also blacken Material3 surface container colors (recommended for full AMOLED).

patches.name: Ads Free Rewards (Experimental)
patches.description: Get rewards without watching ads. Combine with No Ads for other formats, but keep No Ads' rewarded block off.

options.title: Patch version
options.description: Choose the implementation to use. Each version is a snapshot  -  newer ones support more networks. If the latest does not work for your app, try an older version.

options.title: Reward Strategy
options.description: Which ad-network integration to patch. 'Auto' covers every supported network

options.title: Instant reward
options.description: Claim the reward immediately without showing an ad (applies to the current patch version)

options.title: Fake ad availability
options.description: Force ad SDKs to report ads as available so the reward flow triggers (needed when no real ad can fill)

patches.name: Allow Background Activity
patches.description: Makes ActivityManager.isBackgroundRestricted always return false so apps ignore background activity restrictions imposed by the system or user

patches.name: Allow Clearing App Data
patches.description: Sets android:allowClearUserData so the system's Clear Data button stays available even for apps that try to disable it

patches.name: Allow Mixed Content
patches.description: Forces WebSettings.setMixedContentMode(MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW) so WebViews load HTTP resources on HTTPS pages.

patches.name: Allow Mobile Downloads
patches.description: Bandcamp: allows audio cache downloads over mobile data without the confirmation dialog.

patches.name: Allow Text Selection
patches.description: Makes protected text selectable and copyable.

patches.name: Allow WebView Autoplay
patches.description: Forces WebSettings.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false) so media in WebViews can autoplay without a tap.

patches.name: Allow WebView File Access
patches.description: Forces WebSettings file-access flags on so WebViews can load local files and content URLs.

patches.name: Always Allow Biometrics
patches.description: Makes BiometricManager.canAuthenticate always return BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS so apps do not block biometric features on unsupported or unenrolled devices

patches.name: Apk Junk Cleanup
patches.description: Removes unused CPU libraries to shrink the APK. Keep only your device's architecture.

options.title: Keep architecture
options.description: Native libraries for other ABIs under lib/ will be deleted.

patches.name: Block Push Ads
patches.description: Block push notification ads (Firebase Cloud Messaging). Also blocks legitimate notifications.

patches.name: Block Screenshot Detection
patches.description: Adds FLAG_SECURE to every activity window so the system blocks screenshots, screen recording and recents previews of the app

patches.name: Bypass DND Policy Access
patches.description: Lets automation apps work without Do Not Disturb permission.

patches.name: Bypass Demo User
patches.description: Makes UserManager.isDemoUser() report false so apps that gate functionality in retail/demo mode run normally.

patches.name: Bypass Emulator Detection
patches.description: Hides emulator traces by spoofing Build info and related checks so apps cannot detect an emulator.

options.title: Device profile
options.description: Which real device identity to imitate.

options.title: Hide Emulator Radio
options.description: Make TelephonyManager report a normal GSM radio type.

options.title: Spoof Build Extras
options.description: Spoof additional Build and Build.VERSION fields used by emulator checks.

patches.name: Bypass Forced Updates (Experimental)
patches.description: Skip forced update screens and keep using the app.

options.title: Bypass update gate
options.description: Ignore high-confidence client-side checks that report an update is required

options.title: Make dialogs dismissible
options.description: Allow detected update dialogs to be canceled instead of forcing the user to update

options.title: Block update redirects
options.description: Block detected redirects to the Play Store, browser, or updater activity

options.title: Prevent forced exit
options.description: Remove detected finish or exit calls from update-related methods

options.title: Patch Play Core updates
options.description: Disable Google Play's in-app update flow when it is present

patches.name: Bypass Guest User
patches.description: Makes UserManager.isGuestUser() report false so apps that limit guest accounts behave as on a primary account.

patches.name: Bypass Hostname Verification
patches.description: Makes any HostnameVerifier.verify(String, SSLSession) always return true, accepting any certificate hostname without errors.

patches.name: Bypass Instant App
patches.description: Treats instant apps as full installs.

patches.name: Bypass Keyguard Secure
patches.description: Makes KeyguardManager.isKeyguardSecure() report false so apps that require a secure lock screen run without one.

patches.name: Bypass Linked User
patches.description: Makes UserManager.isLinkedUser() report false so apps that restrict linked/secondary profiles run normally.

patches.name: Bypass Lock Task Mode
patches.description: Makes ActivityManager.isInLockTaskMode() report false so apps that change behavior under screen-pinning or kiosk mode run normally.

patches.name: Bypass Low-End Device
patches.description: Makes ActivityManager.isLowEndDevice() report false so apps stop applying low-end-device restrictions and degraded quality.

patches.name: Bypass Managed Profile
patches.description: Treats work profiles as regular profiles.

patches.name: Bypass Overlay Detection
patches.description: Lets apps work with screen overlays.

patches.name: Bypass Package Suspended
patches.description: Makes PackageManager.isPackageSuspended() report false so apps that refuse to run while suspended keep working.

patches.name: Bypass Permission Check
patches.description: Forces permission checks to report granted so permission-gated features skip dialogs

patches.name: Bypass Picture-in-Picture Mode
patches.description: Makes Activity.isInPictureInPictureMode() report false so apps that change behavior in PiP keep their full UI.

patches.name: Bypass Safe Mode
patches.description: Makes PackageManager.isSafeMode() report false so apps that disable functionality in safe mode behave normally.

patches.name: Bypass System User
patches.description: Makes UserManager.isSystemUser() report false so apps gating behavior to the system user treat the current user as normal.

patches.name: Bypass Test Environment
patches.description: Hides test and automation environment.

patches.name: Bypass User Restricted
patches.description: Makes UserManager.isUserRestricted() report false so apps that limit restricted accounts run normally.

patches.name: Bypass WebView SSL Errors
patches.description: Ignores SSL errors in WebView.

patches.name: Bypass WebView Safe Browsing
patches.description: Bypasses deceptive site warnings in WebView.

patches.name: Change Package Name
patches.description: Clone the app with a new package name.

options.title: Custom package name
options.description: Fully custom package name (e.g. com.example.clone). Leave empty to use suffix mode below.

options.title: Package suffix
options.description: Suffix appended to the original package when Custom package name is empty (e.g. .morphe, .clone). Must start with a dot.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Rewrite provider android:authorities that start with the old package to the new package to avoid install conflicts.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Rewrite custom permission android:name that starts with the old package (e.g. C2D_MESSAGE) to the new package.

patches.name: Classic Back Gesture
patches.description: Sets android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback to false so apps that break under the Android 13+ predictive back system keep the classic back behavior

patches.name: Clearing Split Metadata
patches.description: Removes split-install manifest attributes and Play Store split metadata from the app manifest.

patches.name: Custom App Icon
patches.description: Change the app icon.

options.title: Icon source
options.description: Image source: an http(s) URL, a local file path, or base64 (optionally prefixed with 'data:image/png;base64,'). Leave empty to use original icon with effects.

options.title: Hue shift (0-360)
options.description: Hue rotation in degrees (0 = none, 180 = complementary). Applied after other effects.

options.title: Negative (Invert)
options.description: Invert colors (negative).

options.title: Sepia
options.description: Apply sepia tone.

options.title: Flip Horizontal
options.description: Mirror icon horizontally.

options.title: Flip Vertical
options.description: Mirror icon vertically.

patches.name: Disable Activity Transitions
patches.description: No-ops Activity.overridePendingTransition(...) so the app's custom activity enter/exit animations are skipped.

patches.name: Disable Analytics Events
patches.description: Blocks app tracking and analytics.

patches.name: Disable Animations
patches.description: Forces Settings.Global window/transition/animator scale values to 0 so the app runs without UI animations (faster, less motion).

patches.name: Disable App Backup
patches.description: Prevents the app from backing up its data.

patches.name: Disable Autofill
patches.description: Makes AutofillManager report as disabled so apps stop showing autofill prompts.

options.title: Disable
options.description: Report autofill as disabled (true) or enabled (false).

patches.name: Disable Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background uploads to cloud accounts.

patches.name: Disable Bandcamp Tracker
patches.description: Bandcamp: disables the first-party accessibility tracker that pings /api/tracker.

patches.name: Disable Bluetooth A2DP
patches.description: Makes AudioManager.isBluetoothA2dpOn() report false so apps that change behavior when Bluetooth audio is streaming run normally.

patches.name: Disable Bluetooth Discovering
patches.description: Makes BluetoothAdapter.isDiscovering() report false so apps cannot tell the adapter is in discovery mode.

patches.name: Disable Bluetooth SCO
patches.description: Makes AudioManager.isBluetoothScoOn() report false so apps that change behavior when a Bluetooth SCO link is active run normally.

patches.name: Disable Boot Auto-Start
patches.description: Stops the app from starting on its own after reboot.

patches.name: Disable Camera Shutter Sound
patches.description: Silences the camera shutter and video-record sounds by neutralizing MediaActionSound.play(...) and Camera.playSound(...).

patches.name: Disable Clipboard Write
patches.description: No-ops ClipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(...) so the app cannot silently overwrite the system clipboard.

patches.name: Disable Edge-To-Edge Enforcement
patches.description: Opts out of Android 15 mandatory edge-to-edge so apps that break with enforced edge-to-edge render normally.

options.title: Opt out

patches.name: Disable Facebook SDK Auto-Init

patches.name: Disable Firebase Auto-Init
patches.description: Adds Firebase manifest switches that stop Analytics, Messaging, Crashlytics and Performance from initializing themselves at startup

patches.name: Disable Fixed Volume
patches.description: Makes AudioManager.isVolumeFixed() report false so volume keys and stream changes work even when an app pins the volume.

patches.name: Disable Forced Online Checks (Experimental)
patches.description: Lets the app start without internet.

patches.name: Disable Haptic Feedback
patches.description: Disables vibration feedback.

patches.name: Disable Haptic On Scroll
patches.description: Prevents haptic feedback triggered by scrolling.

patches.name: Disable Hardware Acceleration
patches.description: Sets android:hardwareAccelerated="false" on the <application> so the app renders on the software path (fixes some rendering/compat bugs).

patches.name: Disable Heads-up Notifications
patches.description: Blocks pop-up notifications.

patches.name: Disable Heap Pointer Tagging
patches.description: Sets android:allowNativeHeapPointerTagging to false so older native games that break under Android 12+ tagged pointers keep running

patches.name: Disable High Text Contrast
patches.description: Makes AccessibilityManager.isHighTextContrastEnabled() report false so apps do not alter layouts for high-contrast text.

patches.name: Disable Keyboard Sound
patches.description: Silences keyboard and system sounds.

patches.name: Disable Location Requests
patches.description: Stops the app from tracking your location.

patches.name: Disable Logcat Logging
patches.description: No-ops android.util.Log calls so the app stops spamming logcat.

options.title: Log level

patches.name: Disable Music Detection

patches.name: Spoof Data State
patches.description: Makes the app think mobile data is connected.

patches.name: Spoof Developer Options
patches.description: Hides developer options and USB debugging so blocking apps keep working.

patches.name: Spoof Device Software Version
patches.description: Reports a chosen value from TelephonyManager.getDeviceSoftwareVersion() so apps cannot read the real radio/software version.

options.title: Software version
options.description: Version to report.

patches.name: Spoof Fixed Location
patches.description: Fakes your GPS location.

options.title: Latitude
options.description: Fixed latitude to return (e.g. 35.681236 for Tokyo, Japan).

options.title: Longitude
options.description: Fixed longitude to return (e.g. 139.767125 for Tokyo, Japan).

patches.name: Spoof Group ID Level 1
patches.description: Reports a chosen value from TelephonyManager.getGroupIdLevel1() so apps cannot read the real SIM GID1.

options.title: GID1
options.description: GID1 to report.

patches.name: Spoof IMEI
patches.description: Fakes the device IMEI.

options.title: IMEI
options.description: IMEI to report (15 digits).

patches.name: Spoof ISIM IMPI
patches.description: Reports a chosen string from TelephonyManager.getIsimImpi() so apps cannot read the ISIM private identity.

options.title: IMPI
options.description: IMPI to report.

patches.name: Spoof Last Known Location
patches.description: Forces LocationManager.getLastKnownLocation() to return null so apps cannot read the device's last cached GPS/network position.

patches.name: Spoof Locale
patches.description: Forces Locale.getDefault() to return a chosen BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en-US) so region- or language-locked apps see the locale you pick.

options.title: Locale tag
options.description: BCP-47 language tag to report (e.g. en-US, ja-JP, en-GB).

patches.name: Spoof Location Provider
patches.description: Forces LocationManager.getBestProvider() to report "gps" and isProviderEnabled() to report true, so location-dependent apps believe a GPS provider is always available and enabled.

patches.name: Spoof MAC Address
patches.description: Reports a chosen MAC address through WifiInfo.getMacAddress() so apps cannot fingerprint the device by its Wi-Fi MAC.

options.title: MAC address
options.description: MAC address to report (e.g. 02:00:00:00:00:00).

patches.name: Spoof Network Access Identifier
patches.description: Reports a chosen string from TelephonyManager.getNai() so apps cannot read the network access identifier.

options.title: Network Access Identifier
options.description: Identifier to report.

patches.name: Spoof Network Operator Name
patches.description: Fakes the network operator name.

options.title: Operator name
options.description: Operator name to report (e.g. Android, Verzion, T-Mobile).

patches.name: Spoof Network Type LTE
patches.description: Reports NETWORK_TYPE_LTE (13) from TelephonyManager.getNetworkType() so apps that require an LTE connection run on any network.

patches.name: Spoof Phone Number
patches.description: Reports a chosen phone number from TelephonyManager.getLine1Number() and getLine2Number() so apps cannot read the device's phone number.

options.title: Phone number
options.description: Phone number to report (empty hides it).

patches.name: Spoof Ringer Mode
patches.description: Forces AudioManager.getRingerMode() to report RINGER_MODE_NORMAL (2) so apps cannot detect silent or vibrate mode.

patches.name: Spoof SDK Level
patches.description: Reports a chosen Android version. Lower values can crash the app.

options.title: SDK level
options.description: Reported API level (e.g. 29). Use -1 to keep the original.

patches.name: Spoof SIM Country
patches.description: Reports a chosen ISO country (e.g. us) from TelephonyManager.getSimCountryIso() and getNetworkCountryIso() to bypass region locks and geo-restrictions.

options.title: Country ISO
options.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to report (e.g. us, gb, jp).

patches.name: Spoof SIM Operator
patches.description: Reports a chosen MCC+MNC from TelephonyManager.getSimOperator() and getNetworkOperator() so apps cannot read the real mobile network operator.

options.title: MCC+MNC
options.description: Mobile Country Code + Mobile Network Code to report (e.g. 310260).

patches.name: Spoof SIM Operator Name
patches.description: Reports a chosen carrier name from TelephonyManager.getSimOperatorName() and getNetworkOperatorName() so apps cannot read the real carrier display name.

options.title: Operator name
options.description: Carrier display name to report (e.g. T-Mobile, Verizon).

patches.name: Spoof SIM Serial Number
patches.description: Fakes the SIM serial number.

options.title: ICCID
options.description: ICCID to report.

patches.name: Spoof Sensor List
patches.description: Forces SensorManager.getSensorList() to return an empty list so apps cannot enumerate the device's sensors for fingerprinting or capability checks.

patches.name: Spoof Storage State
patches.description: Reports 'mounted' from Environment.getExternalStorageState() so apps that require mounted external storage run normally.

patches.name: Spoof Subscriber ID
patches.description: Reports a chosen subscriber id (IMSI) through TelephonyManager.getSubscriberId() so apps that fingerprint by IMSI see a constant value.

options.title: IMSI
options.description: IMSI to report.

patches.name: Spoof Target SDK
patches.description: Fixes install errors on newer Android versions.

options.title: Target SDK version
options.description: Target SDK level to report in the manifest. Android blocks installing apps targeting below a minimum level on newer versions.

patches.name: Spoof Time Zone
patches.description: Forces TimeZone.getDefault() to return a fixed timezone so region-locked apps see a constant zone (e.g. Europe/London for All4).

options.title: Time zone ID
options.description: IANA time zone ID to spoof (e.g. UTC, Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo).

patches.name: Spoof UiMode Night State
patches.description: Forces UiModeManager to report TYPE_NORMAL and night mode off so car/TV/night gates never trigger

patches.name: Spoof Voice Mail
patches.description: Reports empty strings from TelephonyManager.getVoiceMailNumber() and getVoiceMailAlphaTag() so apps cannot read the voicemail number or tag.

patches.name: Spoof WebView User Agent
patches.description: Replaces WebSettings.getUserAgentString() with a desktop browser user agent so embedded webviews load desktop versions of sites.

patches.name: Spoof WiFi Enabled
patches.description: Forces WifiManager.isWifiEnabled() to report true and getWifiState() to report WIFI_STATE_ENABLED (3) so apps cannot tell Wi-Fi is off.

patches.name: Spoof WiFi RSSI
patches.description: Reports a chosen signal strength from WifiInfo.getRssi() so apps cannot read the real Wi-Fi signal level.

options.title: RSSI (dBm)
options.description: RSSI in dBm (-30 strong, -50 moderate, -80 weak).

patches.name: Spoof WiFi SSID
patches.description: Reports a chosen value from WifiInfo.getSSID() so apps cannot read the real connected network name.

options.title: WiFi SSID
options.description: SSID to report.

patches.name: Spoof Wired Headset
patches.description: Makes AudioManager.isWiredHeadsetOn() report true so apps that require a wired headset think one is connected.

patches.name: Strip BuildConfig DEBUG
patches.description: Forces BuildConfig.DEBUG to false so apps hide debug banners and verbose checks.

options.title: Force debug
options.description: If true, forces DEBUG to true instead of false.

patches.name: Strip Exif Location
patches.description: Makes ExifInterface.getLatLong return null so apps cannot read GPS from photos.

options.title: Strip location
options.description: If true, location is stripped; if false, no change.

patches.name: Strip Package Verifier
patches.description: Makes package verifier appear disabled via Settings so apps skip verification checks.

options.title: Disabled
options.description: Report verifier as disabled or enabled.

patches.name: Treat Screen as On
patches.description: Makes PowerManager.isInteractive always return true so apps keep playing audio or progressing instead of pausing while the screen is off

patches.name: Trust User CAs (Config)
patches.description: Injects a network security config that trusts user-installed CA certificates, enabling MITM/proxy interception for the app.

patches.name: Unlimited Currencies
patches.description: Get unlimited coins, gems and other currencies. Works on most games. Not supported on newer Unity games.

options.title: Amount
options.description: Amount to report for currency. Price fields will be 0.

options.title: Extra keys
options.description: Comma-separated extra keys to spoof (e.g. my_gem,my_coin). Leave empty for default list.

options.title: Infinite mode
options.description: ON: all currencies set to huge amount. OFF: currencies set to the Amount value above.

options.title: Multiply income
options.description: When ON, every time a currency is saved it gets multiplied by the Multiplier value. Useful when infinite mode doesn't work.

options.title: Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier value used in Multiply income mode.

patches.name: Unlock Notification Channels
patches.description: Makes all notification channels blockable and their importance unlocked so greyed-out toggles become interactable.

patches.name: Unlock Playback Speed
patches.description: Bandcamp: applies the playback-rate control to every track instead of podcasts only, so 1x, 1.5x and 2x speeds work for music too.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlock premium features and remove paywalls.

options.title: Extra keys
options.description: Comma-separated extra SharedPreferences/DataStore keys to spoof (e.g. my_premium,my_pro). Leave empty for default list.

patches.name: Unmark Test Only
patches.description: Removes android:testOnly from the manifest so builds marked as test-only can be installed and launched like normal apps

patches.name: VM Safe Mode
patches.description: Sets android:vmSafeMode so the app runs with AOT/JIT optimizations disabled, which can stabilize apps that crash from compiler optimizations on some devices
